Likes Training Planner 1.0.0 – Initial Release

- Provides an all-in-one solution for fetching, analyzing, and generating personalized training plans based on My Likes platform data.
- Supports running, cycling, swimming, and strength training, with options to push plans to the calendar for individuals or groups.
- Includes detailed command-line utilities for data fetching, analysis, plan creation, and bulk operations for coaches.
- Multi-bot Telegram support, auto-routing requests to specialized bots for analysis or plan generation.
- Comprehensive documentation for workflow, configuration, and API script usage.
